label: context.reference
text:
External Configuration Import uses world_external_import. It inspects one explicitly configured source root and emits immutable external_import.candidate artifacts and one external_import.receipt. Candidates require separate authorized installation, project policy, task/artifact bindings, worker-template authoring or Driver setup before use.

The interface never writes the source, Active Registry, EE policy, run JSON, bindings, worker templates, worker-environment kinds or private auth stores. It never copies credentials, tokens, API keys, passwords, OAuth state, cookies or static authorization values. Secret-bearing inputs produce redacted refused receipts with names or handles only.

Instructions, skills, commands, memory and history remain candidates with source provenance. Remote MCP-like capabilities become exact interface/Application candidates; local command-backed capabilities become worker-environment-kind/Driver candidates. Saved user-facing Agents become named worker-template candidates. Imported sessions/threads become history artifacts; they create no run, task, conversation lane, session id or inherited transcript. Hooks become explicit interface-behavior candidates. Record unknown or unsupported fields in unsupported receipts without guessing or dropping them. Later effects need their own authorization and evidence.
